verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only the resource permissions you assign (Read or Write on specific APIs) instead of full account access, which is least-privilege credential issuance. AgentOS is positioned for agents acting on a production account, but the evidence never explicitly ties scoped keys to AgentOS. Missing for 10: explicit agent-specific credential guidance tying scoped keys to AgentOS, evidence of finer controls such as expiry or IP restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
